title: Swift Normalase Amplicon Panels (SNAP): Size Selection and Cleanup Part 2/2
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the protocol parameters, setting park tips to yes (recommended), choosing yes or no for track tips across protocol runs, and selecting yes or no for flash.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware JSON files (.json) if required.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App Protocol tab, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tiprack, and pipette using the OT App; consult support articles for calibration tips if needed.
